adrs.title: Use faster-whisper on CUDA for transcription
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: faster-whisper (CTranslate2) on CUDA float16, because it gives roughly 4x the throughput of the refere...

must: Transcription uses fasterwhisper.WhisperModel; model size, device, compute type and beam size come from config.py env-vars
CUDA is the default device; a missing GPU is reported loudly, never silently downgraded
must_not: Do not send audio to a hosted transcription API
Do not hard-code model size or device outside config.py

adrs.title: Speaker diarization via pyannote.audio 3.1
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: pyannote.audio 3.1 speaker-diarization pipeline, because it is the best-performing open diarization mo...

must: Diarization runs before transcription alignment; speaker segments are passed into transcribeaudio
Model id, min/max speakers come from config.py env-vars
A missing HF token is prompted for, never silently skipped
must_not: Do not depend on WhisperX or another wrapper that pins its own whisper build

adrs.title: Per-task OpenAI model selection
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Per-task model env-vars with length-based switch, because each step has a different cost/quality profi...

must: Every OpenAI call takes its model from a config.py OPENAIMODEL constant
Long inputs route through chooseappropriatemodel
must_not: Do not hard-code a model name string at transcribe.py call sites

adrs.title: Hybrid AI-analysis plus programmatic speaker assignment
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Two-phase: LLM produces mapping, code applies it, because separating judgement (who is SPEAKER02) from...

must: Speaker names are applied by deterministic code from a parsed mapping
Any LLM step that rewrites transcript text is followed by a change analysis
Failure of the analysis phase falls back rather than aborting
must_not: Do not reintroduce a single prompt that outputs the complete renamed transcript as the primary path

adrs.title: Recursive chunked summarization for long transcripts
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Recursive map-reduce summarization with overlap, because it preserves coverage of the whole episode in...

must: Summaries of inputs above MAXINPUTTOKENS go through summarizelargetranscript when USERECURSIVESUMMARIZATION is on
Chunk size and overlap are config constants
must_not: Do not truncate transcript content as the default summary path

adrs.title: Post-transcription vocabulary correction via vocabulary.json
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Post-hoc JSON replacement map, because it is deterministic, testable, editable without code, and survi...

must: Domain term fixes go into vocabulary.json, not into code or prompts
Replacement is word-boundary and longest-match-first
must_not: Do not hard-code term replacements in transcribe.py

adrs.title: Environment-variable configuration and file-based prompts
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Env-vars + config.py constants + prompts/.txt, because it keeps secrets in .env, machine settings in e...

must: New tunables are added to config.py as os.environ.get with a default
New prompts are files in prompts/ with a PROMPTFILE constant
must_not: Do not embed multi-line prompt text in Python source
Do not read os.environ outside config.py except for secrets

adrs.title: Web UI as FastAPI layer over extracted pipeline library
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Option A, because only library extraction gives the web layer structured progress, typed errors, and p...

must: Pipeline code must be importable (import whycast) without side effects: no GPU initialization, no model loading, no filesystem writes at import time.
Pipeline progress and errors must flow through the event sink and logging; library code paths must raise exceptions instead of calling exit().
The web server must bind to 127.0.0.1 by default.
At most one GPU job may run at a time, enforced by the single worker process.
The filesystem remains the source of truth; the SQLite database must be deletable and rebuildable from podcasts/ without data loss.
Any API surface that exposes configuration must use an allowlist of visible keys; secrets (OPENAIAPIKEY, HuggingFace token) must never be returned, masked or otherwise.
must_not: No external job brokers or services (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, cloud queues).
No exit()/sys.exit() in whycast/ library code.
The web layer must not write episode artifacts directly; all artifact writes go through the pipeline library, which writes atomically (write-to-temp, then rename) and backs up files it overwrites.
verification: Golden-master diff test in tests/ (added in phase 0).
Enforcement patterns below (exit( forbidden in whycast/).
Manual: python -c "import whycast" completes without GPU or network activity.

adrs.title: Discard partial downloads and drop per-artifact backups
adrs.decision_summary: Chosen option: Option A, because it removes the noise where it is generated without weakening the primitive: whycast....

must: Artifact writes stay atomic: temp file in the same directory, then os.replace. A partial file must never appear at the target path.
Artifact call sites in whycast/pipeline/ pass backup=False explicitly.
whycast.ioutils keeps backup=True as its default, and that path stays tested.
Audio downloads write through the streaming atomic writer and discard the temp file on any failure.
A download whose body is shorter than the Content-Length the server advertised counts as failed, not complete.
must_not: Do not change the ioutils default to backup=False.
Do not buffer an entire episode in memory to make a download atomic.
Do not back up .env (a .env.bak would be a second plaintext copy of a secret).
